name: Ceejay Finance Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1993, Ceejay Finance 
Ltd company is engaged predominantly 
in automobile financing.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is an Ahmedabad-based deposit-taking NBFC (asset financing company 
 registered with the RBI) that is primarily
 in the vehicle financing business.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.80 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.67% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 10.0% over last 3 years.
